description: Monitoring is the Schema for the monitorings API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: MonitoringSpec defines the desired state of Monitoring.

collectorReplicas.description:
CollectorReplicas specifies the number of replicas in the OpenTelemetry collector.
Defaults to 1 on single-node clusters and 2 on multi-node clusters.

logs.description: Logs configures cluster log forwarding via the ClusterLogForwarder operator.

inferenceNamespaces.description: InferenceNamespaces lists the namespaces whose application logs should be forwarded to Loki.

size.description:
Size selects the log-forwarding LokiStack size. The default is 1x.extra-small;
1x.demo uses fewer resources but does not provide redundancy.

storage.description:
Storage configures the LokiStack storage backend for log forwarding.
Required: the operator deploys a LokiStack dedicated to log forwarding, separate from the
one usageLogs.storage deploys.
The two stacks must use different object storage buckets. Both serve the "application" tenant and
Loki keys objects by tenant rather than by stack, so a shared bucket makes them overwrite each
other's index and chunks. Separate secrets are not sufficient; the operator compares the resolved
endpoint and bucketnames and refuses to reconcile when they overlap.

credentialMode.description:
CredentialMode specifies how credentials are provided to LokiStack.
Valid values: "static", "token", "token-cco".

secretName.description:
SecretName is the name of the Secret containing storage credentials.
For S3: must contain keys: access_key_id, access_key_secret, bucketnames, endpoint, region, insecure, s3ForcePathStyle

storageClassName.description: StorageClassName specifies the storage class for LokiStack PVCs.

managementState.description:
ManagementState controls whether the operator actively manages the
component (Managed) or removes it (Removed).

metrics.description: Metrics configures metrics collection via the MonitoringStack operator.

builtinDCGMScrapeEnabled.description:
BuiltinDCGMScrapeEnabled controls the built-in HTTP scrape for DCGM exporter metrics.
It defaults to enabled; set false when collecting DCGM through a ServiceMonitor or PodMonitor instead.

exporters.description:
Exporters defines custom metrics exporters for external observability tools.
The configuration follows the OpenTelemetry Collector exporter format.
Reserved names 'prometheus' and 'otlp/tempo' cannot be used.
Maximum 10 exporters allowed.

exporter name 'otlp/tempo' is reserved and cannot be used

replicas.description: Replicas specifies the number of replicas in the MonitoringStack.

storage.description: Storage configures the built-in MonitoringStack backend. Omit when using exporters only (external observability).

retention.description: Retention specifies how long metrics data is retained (e.g. "1d", "2w").

size.description: Size specifies the PVC storage size (e.g. "5Gi", "10Mi").

Non-zero replicas require metrics.storage to be configured

namespace.description: Namespace is the target namespace where monitoring resources are deployed.

traces.description: Traces configures distributed tracing via the Tempo operator.

exporters.description: Exporters defines custom trace exporters for external observability tools.

sampleRatio.description: SampleRatio determines the sampling rate for traces (0.0–1.0).

storage.description: Storage configures the built-in Tempo backend. Omit when using exporters only (external observability).

backend.description: Backend defines the storage type: "pv", "s3", or "gcs".

retention.description: Retention specifies how long trace data is retained (e.g. "60m", "10h").

secret.description: Secret is the name of the Secret with storage credentials (non-PV backends).

size.description: Size specifies storage size (PV backend only).

Size is supported when backend is pv only

tls.description: TLS configures TLS for Tempo gRPC connections.

caConfigMap.description: CAConfigMap is the name of the ConfigMap containing the CA certificate.

certificateSecret.description: CertificateSecret is the name of the Secret containing TLS certificates.

enabled.description: Enabled enables TLS for Tempo OTLP ingestion (gRPC/HTTP) and query APIs.

usageLogs.description: UsageLogs configures usage log collection and forwarding to Loki.

attributes.description:
Attributes are resource attributes stamped onto records sent to Exporters only.
They never reach the local write, so a cluster identity added here cannot
disturb the spoke-local pipeline or its dashboards. Set cluster_name and
cluster_id here to attribute records to the cluster that produced them; the
gateway already uses cluster_name for its own upstream cluster, so these are
applied after the pipeline's cleanup stage rather than merged into it.

credentialSecret.description:
CredentialSecret names a Secret in the monitoring namespace holding a bearer
token under the key 'token', for authenticating to the Exporters' endpoint. It
is mounted as a file and read through a bearertokenauth extension named
'bearertokenauth/remote', which an exporter selects with
auth: {authenticator: bearertokenauth/remote}.

The token is never written into the collector object, and because the extension
re-reads the file, rotating the Secret reaches a running collector — projecting
a credential as an environment variable would not, since env vars are read once
at process start. A token also cannot be inlined into an exporter's headers:
exporter values are capped at 1024 characters and a ServiceAccount token is
longer than that.

exporters.description:
Exporters defines additional usage-log exporters, for forwarding a copy of every
usage record to an observability backend outside this cluster — typically a
LokiStack on an ACM hub that aggregates a fleet. The configuration follows the
OpenTelemetry Collector exporter format. They are added alongside the local
write, which is left untouched, making it a dual-write rather than a redirect;
with storage omitted they are the only destination and nothing is written locally.
Reserved name 'otlphttp/loki' cannot be used.
Maximum 10 exporters allowed.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exporter name 'otlphttp/loki' is reserved and cannot be used

size.description:
Size selects the LokiStack t-shirt size for the usage-log store. The default
1x.extra-small requests 1 CPU and 5.25Gi per ingester across three ingesters,
which does not schedule on smaller clusters; the LokiStack then never reports
Ready and the usage-logs collector is never deployed. 1x.demo carries identical
ingestion limits with a single ingester and no resource requests at all, so it
fits where the default cannot, but it has no redundancy. Ignored when storage is
omitted, since no LokiStack is deployed.

storage.description:
Storage configures the LokiStack storage backend (S3).
When configured, the operator deploys a LokiStack instance and auto-configures the collector endpoint.
This stack is separate from the one logs.storage deploys and must use a different object storage
bucket; see logs.storage for why a shared bucket is rejected.
Omit when forwarding only: no LokiStack is deployed and no object storage is needed.

credentialMode.description:
CredentialMode specifies how credentials are provided to LokiStack.
Valid values: "static", "token", "token-cco".

secretName.description:
SecretName is the name of the Secret containing storage credentials.
For S3: must contain keys: access_key_id, access_key_secret, bucketnames, endpoint, region, insecure, s3ForcePathStyle

storageClassName.description: StorageClassName specifies the storage class for LokiStack PVCs.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: usageLogs requires storage and/or at least one exporter
Alerting configuration requires metrics.storage to be configured
CollectorReplicas can only be set when metrics (storage or exporters) or traces are configured, and must be > 0
Log forwarding requires logs.storage to be configured for the LokiStack instance

status.description: MonitoringStatus defines the observed state of Monitoring.

conditions.description: Conditions is the set of condition observations for this module.

items.description:
Condition represents an observation of a module's state at a point in time.
Module controllers set conditions to communicate health signals to the
orchestrator and to human operators.

lastHeartbeatTime.description:
Deprecated: LastHeartbeatTime is present only for backward
compatibility with existing CRDs. New code should not set this field.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from
one status to another.

message.description:
message is a human-readable message indicating details about the
transition.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the
condition was set based upon. If this does not match the resource's
current generation, the condition is likely stale.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for
the condition's last transition. The value should be a CamelCase
string.

severity.description:
Severity indicates whether this condition represents an error or is
purely informational. Empty string (default) indicates error severity.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

logsEndpoint.description:
LogsEndpoint is the Loki query endpoint for forwarded application logs.
Populated when logs is configured and its LokiStack is ready. Unlike
usageLogsEndpoint this is a read endpoint: the ClusterLogForwarder
addresses the LokiStack by name rather than by URL, so there is no write
endpoint to publish.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the most recent .metadata.generation observed
by the controller. It allows consumers to determine whether the
controller has processed the latest spec changes.

phase.description: Phase is the top-level lifecycle phase of the module.

releases.description: Releases is the list of deployed component releases.

items.description: ComponentRelease describes a single software component's release metadata.

name.description: Name is the component name, used as the merge key in lists.

repoUrl.description: RepoURL is the source repository URL for this component release.

version.description: Version is the semantic version of the component.

url.description: URL is the dashboard endpoint when available.

usageLogsEndpoint.description:
UsageLogsEndpoint is the Loki OTLP endpoint for sending usage logs.
Populated when usage-log storage is configured and its LokiStack is ready.

usageLogsForwarding.description:
UsageLogsForwarding names the remote usage-log exporters carried by the deployed
collector. It reports what passed validation and was rendered, so it is empty
when no collector is deployed, which the UsageLogsCollectorAvailable condition
explains.
